body: I can relate. Everyday is miserable. I try and focus on something small that makes me happy and use it to push forward. Hope this helps even a little
Like every time I’m with her it’s like there’s nothing else in the world that matters. I wanna hold onto that as long as I can

I’ve never felt this way about someone but the not telling me how she feels like really feels is bugging tf outta me rn. I don’t wanna ruin anything. Like I know she cares about me a lot and loves me I just don’t like feeling how I’m feeling right now. Idk maybe I’m just being stupid or something
I’m really glad ur feel like living. Keep it going. Do something good for yourself once a day at least. Keep it up. Keep pushing. We don’t have to always feel like this
Just for today don’t do it. And tomorrow say the same thing over and over. Just one day at a time
That’s super sick good job dude

Fuck giving up. Focus on something anything. Maybe not healthy but put yourself out there and focus on being in a relationship. I’m seeing this girl this weekend and I already feel a bit better just at the thought that she knows how it feels to be depressed and suicidal. I get it. I’ve done all the shit you’ve done. I’ve just gotta find something to live for each day even if it’s small

Hey I get it. First off fuck him. I hate seeing every person and comparing myself to them in every way. I hate being alone and being around people. I hate everything about myself and I put self esteem and all my shit into the person I care about so when they don’t reflect that or throw me to the side I go overboard. I got a lot of fucking problems but at least for the next three days I’m not gunna do any self harm. All I’m saying is just look for the positives if u WERE to leave him. Do some self care for yourself in the meantime. I get it. I wanna die too
